fusions.name: Tailwind Lance
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 4 damage to a target up to 7 tiles away, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, with a 25% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fanning Gale
fusions.desc: Fans a gust 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 wind damage to everything in it, knocks them back 3 tiles and leaves them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Straight Flight
fusions.desc: Flies you instantly to a point up to 8 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Nectar Circuit
fusions.desc: Every time you cover a stretch of ground, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
